about: Lac-Beauport is a municipality in the lakes-and-hills country immediately north of Québec City—not a borough of the capital. A four-season recreation community around its namesake lake, it is known for Le Relais ski centre and cottage-to-suburb living on the Jacques-Cartier doorstep. About 8,000 people live in Lac-Beauport.
